name: merchant
description: a Merchant (Fall from Heaven), a cheerful trader: brown hair and a brown moustache under a round green cap with a gold band and a gold button, a long green robe with wide sleeves and gold trim over a white collar, a brown belt with a gold buckle and a small leather pouch, brown boots, a set of brass balance scales with two hanging pans held up by the rod in his LEFT hand (screen-right), and a brown sack of gold coins clutched in his RIGHT arm (screen-left)
hands: the brass balance scales stay in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side keeps hold of the sack of gold coins

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the brass balance scales are lifted up over the head by their rod, the top of the rod pointing up and back, the two pans swinging
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the brass scales cocked behind the head with the rod and the pans hanging down behind the shoulders, the sack of gold coins tucked in against the belly in the other arm
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the rod of the brass scales is level, pointing to the lower-right, the pans flying out
strike.4: contact: the scales arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the brass balance scales swung like a club and smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the arm with the sack of gold coins swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the brass scales carry on down until the top of the rod nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the green robe trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the brass scales lift back toward their upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the sack of gold coins flung out to the left, the scales arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the brass scales dipping, the sack of gold coins still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the scales arm flung up, the sack of gold coins drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the brass scales lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the top of the brass scales' rod resting on the ground, the arm with the sack of gold coins hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the brass scales slip out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the green cap still on his head; the brass scales lie on the ground at the lower-right; the sack of gold coins lies beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the green robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the brass scales and the sack of gold coins on the ground beside him
